_provenance.what: Two measured static properties of the deuteron -- the asymptotic D/S ratio eta_d and the electric quadrupole moment Q_d -- the reference side of validation/benchmarks/t2_deuteron_static.py (BENCHMARK_PLAN.md tier T2; 02_data_nucleon_deuteron.md sec. 5.2).
_provenance.transcription: SECOND-HAND.  Both numbers are copied from THIS REPOSITORY'S OWN PROSE at git revision f0a8f1e, NOT from the papers: eta_d = 0.0256(4) from docs/benchmarking/02_data_nucleon_deuteron.md sec. 5.2 (line 285, the 'value' row; the reference row is line 284; sec. 10 line 451 repeats the attribution), Q_d = +0.2859(3) fm^2 from include/lipolgen/b1_nuclear.hpp lines 121-128 (the 'THE 100 % BAND IS MANDATORY' block, which cites 'Bishop and Cheung, Phys. Rev. A 20 (1979) 381').  NEITHER SOURCE PAPER WAS RE-READ for this file: both are paywalled and the publishers' hosts were unreachable from the environment that wrote it.  The survey marks the Rodning-Knutson REFERENCE as VERIFIED (its bibliographic record, INSPIRE 312974); it prints the VALUE as a single quoted number.

_provenance.licence: The two numbers are measured physical quantities (facts).  The in-tree prose they were copied from is GPL-3.0-or-later, as is this file.  The papers' own terms were not consulted: the papers were not obtained.

papers.eta_d: N. L. Rodning, L. D. Knutson, 'Asymptotic D-state to S-state ratio of the deuteron', Phys. Rev. C 41 (1990) 898 (INSPIRE 312974); the earlier Phys. Rev. Lett. 57 (1986) 2248 (INSPIRE 1476759) -- as 02_data_nucleon_deuteron.md sec. 5.2 cites them.  Method, per that survey: d + 4He sub-Coulomb tensor analysing powers.  One determination; the survey quotes no world average and none was consulted here.
papers.Q_d: D. M. Bishop, L. M. Cheung, Phys. Rev. A 20 (1979) 381 -- as include/lipolgen/b1_nuclear.hpp:127-128 cites it (docs/open_items/run_2026-09-02/design_D_b1_li6.md sec. 4.3 adds 'as used by Ericson & Rosa-Clot').  Title and method are not stated anywhere in the tree; the paper was not re-read.

publishing_convention.eta_d: Dimensionless: A_D/A_S, the ratio of the asymptotic normalisations of the deuteron's radial S and D waves, u(r) -> A_S exp(-kappa r) and w(r) -> A_D exp(-kappa r) [1 + 3/(kappa r) + 3/(kappa r)^2] as r -> infinity.  Independent of the wave function's overall normalisation.  PER DEUTERON (a property of the bound n-p state).  Positive for the physical deuteron (the relative S-D sign that gives Q_d > 0).
publishing_convention.Q_d: The electric (spectroscopic, M = J = 1) quadrupole moment of the deuteron in fm^2 (e fm^2 with e = 1), PER DEUTERON.  A MEASURED value, so it contains everything nature puts in it (two-body currents, relativistic corrections), which an impulse-approximation model Q_d omits.
publishing_convention.errors: The parenthesised digits as the tree prints them, read here as one standard deviation on the last digits: 0.0256(4) -> sigma 0.0004; 0.2859(3) -> sigma 0.0003 fm^2.  Whether the papers quote 1 sigma, and whether statistical or total, was not checked.
